verdict.rationale: Agora's own materials say it supports mobile apps and web. They also reference an RTC SDK built on a single channel model: join a channel with a UID, then publish and subscribe to streams. That suggests a shared session model across clients, but the evidence never names official web, iOS and Android SDKs or confirms the model is identical on each. Missing for 10: explicit listing of official web/iOS/Android SDKs, documentation that the session and track model is the same across platforms, confirmation that one backend and token flow serves all platforms, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, official client SDKs cover web, iOS, and Android with the same session and track model, so one backend serves every platform

citations.quote: Supporting mobile apps, web, and phone calls; reaching users on any device or channel.
Admins enable users to use RTC SDK in network-restricted environments
When joining a channel, you have the option to either assign a specific UID to the user or pass `0` or `null` and allow Agora to automatically generate and assign a UID to the user.
